Exercise: Floor Press

Category:
powerlifting

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- vertical_push

Primary Muscles:

- triceps

Secondary Muscles:

- chest
- shoulders

Equipment:

- barbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC and glycolytic

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- strength_gains_in_the_upper_body
- hypertrophy_of_the_chest,_triceps,_and_shoulders

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Chest pain or discomfort

Exercise Variations:

- name: Close-Grip Floor Press, primaryMuscles: ['triceps']
- name: Wide-Grip Floor Press, primaryMuscles: ['chest']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Incline Dumbbell Press, equipment: dumbbells
- exercise_name: Bench Press, equipment: barbell

Instructions:

- Adjust the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. Begin lying on the floor with your head near the end of a power rack. Keeping your shoulder blades pulled together; pull the bar off of the hooks.
- Lower the bar towards the bottom of your chest or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to pull it apart as you do so. Ensure that you tuck your elbows throughout the movement. Lower the bar until your upper arm contacts the ground and pause, preventing any slamming or bouncing of the weight.
- Press the bar back up as fast as you can, keeping the bar, your wrists, and elbows in line as you do so.
